description: This file contains implementation of various activation functions and their backward passes for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend within PyTorch. It includes functions like ReLU, log_softmax, log_sigmoid, GELU, Mish, PReLU, Softplus, and SiLU, with optimizations for GPU acceleration via MPS. The code manages external MPS graph objects, caching mechanisms, and memory handling strategies specific to Apple's ML hardware.

methods.name: silu_out_mps
methods.description: Computes the forward pass of the SiLU activation function on MPS backend, caching the computation graph for efficiency, and copying the result if necessary.

methods.name: silu_backward_out_mps
methods.description: Computes the backward pass of SiLU activation on MPS backend, caching the computation graph, and producing the gradient input.

methods.name: hardtanh_backward_mps
methods.description: Performs the backward pass of Hardtanh activation function, returning a tensor with computed gradients.

methods.name: hardtanh_backward_out_mps
methods.description: Computes the gradient of Hardtanh activation function and writes the output into provided tensor.
